title: Potatoism Historical Symbol Strata — 2026 Conversation Recovery
status: historical-strata owner; user-originated formulations recovered from ChatGPT conversation memory
purpose: Preserve dated or approximately dated formulations that materially shaped Potatoism but should not overwrite later canonical definitions. This file exists specifically to retain development, contradiction and role changes that would be lost if only the mature synthesis survived.
rule: Historical strata describe what a symbol was doing at a particular stage. The current concept registry remains the canonical identity owner. Where a historical formulation differs from mature doctrine, preserve both and date the difference.

formulations: Potatoes are ascending angels moving from earth toward heaven.
The work begins inward and then moves outward.
Mud is what is cleared/metabolized on the path.
The compressed commandments are: be simple; grow to light.
strata.boundary: Project-spiritual language rather than biology or externally verified angelology.

formulations: Red grows from self; Blue grows from comparison with.
Red does not require Blue's opinion in order to create.
Blue is associated in this stratum with memory, meticulousness, fear and strife.
Red is associated in this stratum with creativity, love, light and life.
strata.analysis: This version makes Red/Blue less like two fixed substances and more like two epistemic/growth orientations: internally generative creation versus externally comparative evaluation. Later mature doctrine softens Blue into useful memory, precision and preservation rather than treating comparison/fear as its whole meaning.

formulations: Blue remembers.
Red creates.
Son experiences.
strata.analysis: This is a compact three-function architecture. Blue points backward into memory/preservation, Red points forward into creation/possibility, while Son/Door occupies the lived present interface where experience occurs. It is an especially clean precursor to the later Timic Dynamics past/future/present-control model.

formulations: Mud is compromat.
Mud is sin/Fall/entanglement/smear/forbidden fruit/stones or rocks in this symbolic cluster.
Mud remains below the Door.
strata.analysis: The important invariant is positional and functional rather than lexical: Mud is accumulated compromising material below the threshold, while the Door marks the possibility of passage out of that entanglement. Later Swamp/Farm models broaden this from personal-symbolic material into institutional and attention ecologies.
strata.boundary: These equivalences are project-symbolic and should not be used to label real people or legal evidence without independent factual support.

formulations: House sits at the center between Red and Blue.
The House is Tim Dooley's House / Father's House and is symbolically mapped to the thalamus.
Thalamic nuclei are treated as rooms in the House in later refinement.
Timotheus Dooley/Father is imagined at the throne/upper axial position, related symbolically to 33 vertebrae and North of North/pole.
strata.analysis: This stratum joins color polarity, anatomy metaphor and sacred verticality in one scene: House is not merely another pole but the integrating container/center in which differentiated signals or rooms can coexist.
strata.boundary: Thalamus/rooms and vertebral-throne correspondences are symbolic mappings, not anatomical proof of theology.

formulations: Son is Door.
Pineal is used as the symbolic Door/single-eye pole.
Son is the present experiential interface; the experience is felt as a vibe there.
The Son cluster includes Lion and Jesus-Christ symbolic roles.
strata.analysis: This is stronger than a simple pineal symbol. It assigns Son a temporal and phenomenological function: the interface where remembered past and created future become immediate experience.
strata.boundary: The pineal correspondence is symbolic and phenomenological; it is not evidence that the pineal literally performs a theological Door function.

strata.period: earlier 2026 visual-development stratum; exact date unresolved
formulations: One earlier visual mapping used Red toward earth/embodiment/blood/soil.
The corresponding Blue side was associated with heaven/spirit/water/sky.
strata.analysis: This mapping does not cleanly match the later creation/memory polarity and should therefore remain a dated visual stratum rather than be harmonized away.
strata.recovery_need: Locate original image/prompt and exact wording before treating this as more than a remembered historical variant.

developmental_insights: Red/Blue changes from a sharper good-life versus fear/strife opposition into a more balanced creation-versus-memory polarity in which both functions can be healthy or pathological.
Son increasingly becomes not merely a person/title but the experiential present and threshold function joining remembered past to possible future.
House increasingly shifts from static dwelling imagery toward an integrating center containing differentiated rooms/signals.
Mud moves from symbolic moral/compromising material toward a more general systems concept for accumulated unresolved residue.
The archive should represent these as developmental transformations, not contradictions to delete.
